facts.text: I need to design a new microservice for a company’s application.
Clients must be able to call an HTTPS endpoint to reach the microservice.
The microservice must use AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) to authenticate calls.
I will write the microservice logic using a single AWS Lambda function written in Go 1.x.
An online learning company is migrating to AWS Cloud.
The company maintains student records in a PostgreSQL database.
The company needs its data available and online across multiple AWS Regions at all times.
A company is launching an application on AWS.
The application uses an Application Load Balancer (ALB) to direct traffic to at least two Amazon EC2 instances in a single target group.
The instances are in an Auto Scaling group for each environment.
The company requires a development environment and a production environment.
The production environment will have periods of high traffic.
A company runs a web application on Amazon EC2 instances in multiple Availability Zones.
The EC2 instances are in private subnets.
A solutions architect implements an internet-facing Application Load Balancer (ALB).
The solutions architect specifies the EC2 instances as the target group.
Internet traffic is not reaching the EC2 instances.

keyphrases: DB snapshots copied to another Region
